findings.title: Workflow diagram uses `<DATE>-<name>` while every other doc uses `<YYYY-MM-DD>-<name>`
findings.recommendation: The workflow ASCII diagram at README.md:166 uses `<DATE>-<name>` (compact form chosen for box-width constraints during iter-3 W2 cleanup). Every other doc — CLAUDE.md:30, orbit-conventions:157, orbit-archive-modifications spec (multiple lines), README.md:449, the new canonical baseline specs — uses `<YYYY-MM-DD>-<name>`. A reader who only sees the workflow diagram lacks the date format specification. Either widen the diagram to fit `<YYYY-MM-DD>-<name>`, or add a note adjacent to the diagram ("see Installation / Persistence Layout sections for date format"). Low priority; doesn't break any operationalizable reference, just slightly less self-explanatory in one location.
